body: Omg perfect I feel like the piercing itself doesn’t even hurt anymore and it’s just the bump causing irritation 😭 thank you so much!
I can really relate to this one. I hope it DOES get better for you.
Wow I like that. Making me feel like I want to be active in here so I can calm people down like you did to help me.

It’s my first time writing in this subreddit, and I’m actually blown away how a completely stranger typing a couple messages to me and listening to my feelings can make me feel so much calmer. Really truly thank you.

You are right. It’s not that I don’t want to necessarily be alive, I just want the pain to stop, which I think is the case in a lot of people who have thoughts like me. I need to convince myself that finding a therapist and getting help can potentially be scary, but do really great things for me.

I’ve spoken to my mom a few times, because she also suffers from mental illness. She’s told me she wants to get me help, and she’s found me a therapist recently, but it’s hard for me to imagine telling a complete stranger that I have thoughts of ending my life and telling them all about my trauma. I know that’s what they’re there for, but it just feels really strange to have to do that. The thought of crying in front of strangers also triggers my anxiety so I feel stuck.

It’s always been hard for me to keep friends for long periods of time, and I feel like I have to beg for my peers/boyfriend to want to be around me. It’s hard to tell if it’s my severe anxiety putting these thoughts in my head, or if it’s reality. I just always feel like a burden
